review: The theorem explicitly covers finite independent universal-sink clouds over arbitrary loopless directed four-cores, with independent nonnegative tail and head activities.
Boolean ordered disjoint endpoint supports are counted once regardless of matching witnesses.
The coefficients a,b,c,d and gamma1 through gamma4 match independent exhaustive Boolean and Hall reconstruction.
The sink moment upper bound, its monotone substitution direction, and its closure interpretation are correct.
The target Q=G2^2-2*G1*G3 equals 4*(gamma2^2-3*gamma1*gamma3) after boundary substitution.

Certificate schema and all counts match the independent exact replay: 218 classes, 3532 polynomial squares, 64298 positive remainder monomials, 127 binomial-only certificates and 91 richer certificates.
The actual-degree first-gap mass-shifting proof uses an active-arc compatibility graph and deliberately overcounts rank-two witnesses only for an upper bound.
The ordinary quartic proof supplies gamma3^2 >= (32/9)*gamma2*gamma4 with correctly normalized core and sink inequalities.
Actual degree rho is distinct from core coefficient d, and the degree 0,1,2,3,4 closure uses each correct binomial normalization.
Zero-tail vertices remain possible heads. All nonnegative faces are covered without a separate three-active-tail theorem or a padded-degree inference.
The preorder statement correctly reinstates the diagonal; universal-source reversal is valid.
Primary sources support only the stated classical inequalities. No general rank-ULC, stability, real-rootedness, formalization, or novelty assertion is inferred.
All five final pages were visually inspected. No clipping, overlap, broken equations, or missing glyphs were found.
An independent fresh 105-dpi render is byte-identical to every inspected page image.
resolved_scope_clarifications: The preorder remark explicitly adjoins the diagonal.
